site.name: GeoScore
site.tagline: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) audit tool with free browser audits, Chrome MV3 extension, live SVG badges, CLI, and MCP server
site.description: GeoScore is an open-source tool that scores any website 0-100 across 11 weighted dimensions of AI search visibility (plus negative signals and prompt injection safety deductions). It audits AI crawler access across 20 bots (robots.txt), machine-readable guidance (llms.txt, JSON-LD schema), discovery endpoints, and E-E-A-T authority signals, then generates deployable fix files tailored to Static HTML, Next.js, WordPress, and Shopify. Free single browser audits, Chrome Extension v1.9.0, CLI, and MCP server are available alongside optional Pro monitoring and a one-time $49 Fix Pack.
site.audience: Web developers, SEO professionals, content marketers, SaaS founders, ecommerce stores, publishers

what_we_offer.name: GEO Audit (Single URL, Batch Sitemap, Compare Sites)
what_we_offer.description: Score any public URL 0-100 across 11 dimensions and 85+ checks in three unified modes: Single URL, Batch Sitemap, and Compare Sites

what_we_offer.name: Live GEO Score SVG Badges
what_we_offer.description: Embed dynamic cache-backed SVG score badges for any public domain in GitHub READMEs and site footers via /badge/<domain>

what_we_offer.description: Done-for-you GEO fix package: custom llms.txt built from your catalog, AI-crawler robots.txt rules, Product schema completion, a 1-page audit, and a post-deploy re-audit within 48 hours. One-time $49.

geo_dimensions: Meta & Social (Open Graph, Twitter Card, canonical URL, HTML lang, 10%)
